facts.fact: The article '9 strategic tips for international targeting' was published on 2023-06-07.
The GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) has been specifically enforced in Europe since 2018, according to the article.
facts.quote: One pronounced law, specifically enforced in Europe since 2018, is GDPR, or General Data Protection Regulation.

facts.fact: Under GDPR, users must consent to being tracked via cookies, and they must be able to withdraw that consent at any time.
facts.quote: they must have the ability to withdraw consent at any time.

facts.fact: The article states that winter in the US runs from December to February, while winter in Australia runs from June to August.
facts.value: December to February (US); June to August (Australia)
facts.quote: winter in the US is from December to February, but it is from June to August in Australia

facts.fact: The article states that China, India, and the US lead in the number of smartphone users, citing Statista.
facts.quote: Device use differs internationally. China, India, and the US lead with the

facts.fact: As a dayparting example, the article suggests that ads for a takeout dinner option would be ideal between 3pm and 7pm.
facts.quote: showing ads between the hours of 3pm and 7pm would be ideal.

facts.fact: The article notes that some countries are almost a full day ahead of the account's time zone, so international campaigns may need to end a day earlier or later.
facts.quote: Some countries are almost a full day ahead based on the difference in time

facts.fact: Per Insider Intelligence (cited by StackAdapt), in 2022, 67% of Americans listened to digital audio, a 5% year-over-year increase.
facts.quote: in 2022, [67% of Americans](https://www.insiderintelligence.com/content/us-population-listens-digital-audio) listened to digital audio, a 5% increase year-over-year

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that campaigns running in Europe should ask users for consent before tracking their data, explain how the data will be used, and offer an opt-out option if necessary.
facts.quote: If you’re running your next campaign in Europe, make sure you are asking for consent from the user to track their data—explaining how their data will be used and giving them an opt-out option if necessary.

facts.fact: StackAdapt notes that some regions have differing online advertising privacy policies, citing CCPA in California as an example.
facts.quote: Some countries have differing policies based on region—like [CCPA in California]

facts.fact: StackAdapt advises checking a landing page's domain before launching a campaign in new localities to confirm compliance with the digital laws of the target countries or regions.
facts.quote: it’s imperative that you double check your landing page’s domain to ensure you are complying with the digital laws of the countries (or regions) you wish to run in.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that the number of available impressions in a country is composed of the number of users online there and the amount of international ad inventory.
facts.quote: The number of available impressions is composed of the number of users that are online in that country, and the amount in international ad inventory.
